content.text:
I've read the release and the brief line by line. Here is my check.

**Key observations**

- **Free cash flow period error.** The release's `~$8,700` million carries footnote 6: "Second-quarter YTD 2026 is estimated." The brief presents it as "for the second quarter" — a year-to-date figure passed off as the quarter. It also drops the prior-year `$6,214` million comparison.
- **Segment reported figures missing.** The brief cites only operational growth for both segments (6.8% and 3.6%, both correctly labeled). It never gives the reported dollar sales ($16,384M / $8,926M) or reported growth (7.8% / 4.5%), so those facts are absent rather than misstated.
- **"Range ... at the midpoint" confusion.** Three Outlook bullets attach "at the midpoint" to full guidance ranges. The ranges themselves are accurate, but the release's midpoints are 6.5%, $11.58 and $11.68 — a range is not a midpoint. Notably the Results section gets this right ("$11.68 ... at the midpoint"), so the brief contradicts itself.
- **Product/indication mix-up.** The brief attributes the psoriatic-arthritis joint-damage indication to the Dual Energy THERMOCOOL SMARTTOUCH SF platform. The release attaches that indication solely to TREMFYA; THERMOCOOL is listed as a separate approval (and footnoted as subsequent to the quarter).
- Worldwide operational (5.6%) / adjusted operational (5.7%) growth and the STELARA ~760bps headwind are not mentioned at all.

facts.evidence: Reported sales growth of 6.6% to $25.3 billion.
increased adjusted EPS guidance by $0.13 to $11.68 or 8.2% at the midpoint.
Raised 2026 guidance with estimated reported sales of $101.1 billion or 7.3% at the midpoint
Free cash flow estimated at ~$8.7 billion for the second quarter.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 reported sales grew 6.6% to $25.3 billion.
Q2 2026 earnings per share (EPS) was $2.27.
Q2 2026 adjusted EPS was $2.90.
The company raised 2026 guidance, with estimated reported sales of $101.1 billion, or 7.3% growth, at the midpoint.
The company increased adjusted EPS guidance by $0.13 to $11.68, or 8.2%, at the midpoint.
Innovative Medicine worldwide operational sales grew 6.8%.
Innovative Medicine growth was driven by DARZALEX, CARVYKTI, TECVAYLI and RYBREVANT/LAZCLUZE.
MedTech worldwide operational sales grew 3.6%.
MedTech growth was driven by wound closure products, biosurgery products and trauma.
2026 adjusted operational sales guidance was raised to 6.2% - 6.8% at the midpoint.
claims.note: Range is correct (6.2%-6.8%, up from 5.6%-6.6%), but it is the full guidance range, not the midpoint; the release's midpoint is 6.5%.

claims.claim: 2026 adjusted operational EPS guidance was increased to $11.50 - $11.65 at the midpoint.
claims.note: Range is correct (up from $11.30-$11.50), but it is the range, not the midpoint; the release's midpoint is $11.58.

claims.claim: 2026 adjusted EPS guidance was increased to $11.60 - $11.75 at the midpoint.
claims.note: Range is correct (up from $11.45-$11.65), but it is the range, not the midpoint; the release's midpoint is $11.68 (which the brief states correctly elsewhere).

claims.claim: Free cash flow was estimated at ~$8.7 billion for the second quarter.
claims.note: The ~$8,700 million figure is second-quarter year-to-date 2026 (footnote 6), not the quarter alone; the release gives no standalone Q2 free cash flow.

claims.claim: TREMFYA was approved to inhibit the progression of structural joint damage in adults with active psoriatic arthritis.
CAPLYTA received FDA approval for the prevention of relapse in schizophrenia.
The Dual Energy THERMOCOOL SMARTTOUCH SF platform was approved for inhibiting the progression of structural joint damage in adults with active psoriatic arthritis.
claims.note: Contradicts the release: the psoriatic arthritis joint-damage indication belongs to TREMFYA. THERMOCOOL SMARTTOUCH SF is listed as a separate FDA approval with no indication stated (and footnoted as subsequent to the quarter).
